of.needed: whether the environment monitors certificate expiration metrics from Citadel

consequence.statement: Certificate expiration metrics from Citadel will now accurately reflect the current certificate expiration times when new certificates are loaded, rather than stale values from previously loaded certificates.

assertion.statement: The citadel_server_root_cert_expiry_timestamp, citadel_server_root_cert_expiry_seconds, citadel_server_cert_chain_expiry_timestamp, and citadel_server_cert_chain_expiry_seconds metrics now update when new certificates are loaded.
